title: Always Show Window Pane Toggles
description: ui: All window pane toggles must be visible all the time like window options. dont hide them when the window is not active
summary:
Window Actions and Search pane toggles now stay mounted on inactive windows, matching Window Options and Utilities.

Root cause: `engagementVisible` / `searchVisible` required `active`, and an effect force-folded both rails whenever the window lost focus — so inactive windows lost the chrome toggles entirely while measures/utility stayed.

Fix:
1. Dropped the `active` gate from engagement/search visibility (still collapse when measures are fullscreen).
2. Removed the auto-fold-on-deactivate effect so fold state is independent of focus, like measures.
3. Keyboard search routing still requires the globally active window.
4. Replaced the old "hides while inactive" regression with one that asserts all four pane chrome toggles remain reachable and unfoldable on an inactive window.

Verified: targeted Window vitest cases pass (5 filtered + full Window* suite).
